programme.title: Heart of the Matter
programme.desc: A professional photographer visits her hometown and becomes reacquainted with a man who once broke her heart.

programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: A spoiled rich girl loses her fortune and is forced to take a job in the real world, where the developing relationship with her new boss and his young son opens her eyes to what money can't buy.

programme.title: Backyard Wedding
programme.desc: A med-school graduate (Alicia Witt) returns to her childhood home to plan her backyard wedding. Her ex-husband and former neighbor(Teddy Sears) is also in town, and his presence forces her to reevaluate how strong her current relationship truly is just days before the wedding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage
programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.title: Mr. Write
programme.desc: When editor Dori meets her idol, romantic novelist Michael, she's crushed to learn he doesn't really believe in true love. But when Dori's own romance falls apart, only Michael can pick up the pieces and renew her belief in love and in him.

programme.title: Mr. Fiction
programme.desc: Emma, a young bookshop owner and hopeless romantic, has to make some tough life choices when the man of her dreams walks into her store.

programme.title: Shadow on the Mesa
programme.desc: A gunslinger seeks out the father he never met while looking for answers about his mother's murder. When he arrives at his father's ranch, he finds himself in the middle of a war over the land.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: Miles From Nowhere
programme.desc: A high-school football player (Andrew Lawrence) copes with his best friend's death by training to run a sub-four-minute mile. But his quest puts him at odds with his father (Treat Williams) after he begins to neglect football. Joanna Going also stars. Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: Easy Heart
programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.title: Hopeless Romantic
programme.desc: Matt's proposal to his girlfriend is rejected, so he attempts to devise a plan to win her back by watching romantic comedies.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.title: Resting Place
programme.desc: Story about a major (John Lithgow) who battles racism while trying to bury a black Vietnam hero in an all-white cemetery. Luther: Morgan Freeman. Ada: C.C.H. Pounder. Eudora: Frances Sternhagen. Sam: G.D. Spradlin. Sarge: M. Emmet Walsh. Hauer: Richard Bradford. Directed on location by John Korty.

programme.title: Foxfire
programme.desc: Jessica Tandy and Hume Cronyn re-create their Broadway roles as homesteaders in this study of change and tradition in Appalachia. Tandy won an Emmy (after earning a Tony on stage). Dillard: John Denver. Prince: Gary Grubbs. Holly: Harriet Hall. Filmed in Highlands, N.C., and Rabun County, Ga. Directed by Jud Taylor. Adapted by Susan Cooper, who co-wrote the original play with Cronyn.

programme.title: Woman of the House
programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.title: Can't Buy My Love
programme.desc: Lilly, an EMT and aspiring medical student falls for Jeff, a rich, aimless guy.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: An ex-Olympian (Jessica Cauffiel), who abandoned her figure-skating career following a tragic accident, reluctantly begins coaching an aspiring skater (Noelle Bruno). But their local practice rink could soon shut its doors for good as the new owner (Brady Smith) struggles to make ends meet. Jerry Stiller, Shelley Long and Kathleen Wilhoite also star. Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. During the recovery process, she befriends a rough-around-the-edges patient (Fiona Dourif) and her neighbor (Rick Malambri), a former rodeo cowboy who encourages her to return to horseback riding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.desc: An introvert journalist researches a magazine article by going out with different men every month.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.desc: After dastardly deity Gerard Butler kills his father and leaves him blind, Horus teams up with a plucky young thief to take revenge. Fantasy epic with Chadwick Boseman.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: A bright red demon is the FBI's key weapon for fighting Nazis and nasties. Ron Perlman stars. Violence/flashing images.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Ace assassin Jason Statham becomes a target when he agrees to teach reckless Ben Foster the art of contract killing. Gritty action thriller.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Madcap superhero action as Seth Rogen and Jay Chou become amateur crime-fighters. With Cameron Diaz. Moderate violence/strong language/sexual references/flashing images.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: As the legendary monster resurfaces, will he prove to be humanity's unlikely saviour? Blockbuster with Bryan Cranston.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: Tom Hardy and Charlize Theron star in George Miller's action adventure about a rebel and a drifter who team up in post-apocalyptic Australia.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Lucy Liu and Drew Barrymore star as the crime-fighting trio in this explosive action comedy. Violence/sex.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
programme.desc: Foxy crimefighters Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore and Lucy Liu spring into action to stop a murder plot led by rogue 'angel' Demi Moore. Violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence cause mayhem as they investigate a drug smuggling operation. Action. Language/violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Monkey Man
programme.desc: Action thriller directed by and starring Dev Patel. A nameless young man known only as Kid makes his living as a masked participant at a seedy underground fight club where he is beaten up regularly. But there is method in his madness, as he works toward exacting revenge against those responsible for his traumatic past.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Antiheroes
programme.desc: From Dirty Harry and The Godfather to the deeply imperfect gang from the Fast and the Furious franchise, this Cinema List celebrates our favourite anti-heroes.

programme.title: Cult Killer
programme.desc: After a private investigator is murdered, his protégé discovers the grisly secrets of their town. Difrector Jon Keeyes' thriller, starring Antonio Banderas, Alice Eve and Shelley Hennig.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Action crime thriller starring Tom Cruise. When five innocent people are gunned down in Pittsburgh, all evidence points to former US Army sniper James Barr. However, Barr refuses to confess to the crime, and sends out word for ex-military investigator Jack Reacher to clear his name. Despite being no friend of Barr's, Reacher looks into the murders and discovers the victims may not have been so randomly selected after all.

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Action sequel starring Tom Cruise and Cobie Smulders. After being wrongly accused of murder, Jack Reacher goes on the run with Major Turner, who has been accused of selling government secrets. Can they clear their names before being caught?

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby, a young getaway driver with tinnitus, takes part in a heist which seems doomed to fail, especially as the characters involved lose touch with reality as events spiral out of control. Writer/director Edgar Wright's Bafta-winning, music-themed action thriller, starring Ansel Elgort, Lily James, Jamie Foxx, Kevin Spacey and Jon Hamm.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Supernatural horror comedy sequel starring Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder and Jenna Ortega. In the decades since narrowly avoiding marriage to the lascivious demon Betelgeuse, Lydia Deetz has found fame as a TV occultist. Her teenage daughter, Astrid, is sceptical and distant, still mourning the death of her father some years before. But then Astrid has her own perilous brush with the beyond - and her despairing mother realises there's only one being who can help her out...

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Futuristic action epic starring Anya Taylor-Joy and Chris Hemsworth. As a child, Furiosa is kidnapped from the "Green Place" by wasteland marauders ruled by the despotic Dementus, who murders her mother. Growing up to find herself caught in the crossfire between two rival warlords, Furiosa devises a plan to escape and to take revenge on Dementus.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Tom Hardy and Charlize Theron. In a world where water is precious and humanity faces extinction, a one-armed woman takes off across the desert with a lorry-load of females who've been imprisoned to bear children. Riding shotgun is Max, the infamous "Road Warrior".

programme.title: Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Vin Diesel. Abandoned on a derelict planet, outlaw warrior Riddick must fight for survival against vicious alien predators. His only way of escape is to activate a distress beacon left behind by mercenaries.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Action thriller based on the novel by Tom Clancy, starring Ben Affleck and Morgan Freeman. Rookie CIA agent Jack Ryan is thrust to the fore when a politician he has been studying unexpectedly becomes Russian president. He immediately finds himself at odds with his superiors when he has to convince them that the new man in the Kremlin is not behind the detonation of a bomb at a Baltimore football stadium.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: Action crime thriller based on the Marvel comic, starring Tom Jane, John Travolta, Will Patton and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos. Undercover FBI special agent Frank Castle agrees to one final operation before retiring, but it all goes wrong when Florida gangster Howard Saint's son is killed in the process. Swearing revenge for his child, Saint orders the murder of Castle and his entire family. But Castle survives, and sets out to destroy every aspect of Saint's life.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Superhero action adventure starring Dakota Johnson. While on a dangerous job, New York paramedic Cassie Webb has a near-fatal accident and develops precognitive powers. When she foresees that three young women are in danger, she sets out to protect them from the super-powered villain who wants them dead.

programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock and symbiote partner-in-crime Venom are lying low in Mexico City, on the run for the apparent murder of detective Patrick Mulligan. The cop and his bonded entity, Toxin, are actually alive at the Imperium symbiote containment programme, beneath the Area 51 US Air Force facility in the Nevada desert. Knull, the symbiotes' immortal creator, dispatches hunters to locate Venom's hidden power source, the Codex, which can set Knull free to terrorise the multiverse. Fantasy adventure, starring Tom Hardy, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Stephen Graham and Juno Temple.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: Epic crime drama starring Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Robert Duvall and Diane Keaton. Michael Corleone is determined to legitimise the family business, but struggles to escape its violent past. With his leadership challenged by rival factions, Michael becomes increasingly obsessed with family loyalty, as he remembers his late father's first, challenging days in America.

programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Vin Diesel, Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Charlize Theron. The whole team have dispersed to live quieter lives. But with Dom seemingly seduced into a life of techno terrorism by the mysterious Cipher, it looks like the opportunity to put their feet up will have to wait.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio as a corporate spy who steals ideas from dreams. But his latest, most dangerous assignment requires him to implant a thought and it pulls him deep into a battle with his own subconscious where he is haunted by memories of his dead love.

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure based on the Marvel Comics character, starring Wesley Snipes as vampire killer Blade. In a world where vampires and humans co-exist in relative harmony, maverick bloodsucker Deacon Frost (Stephen Dorff) threatens to unleash a powerful force that will take over the Earth. Only Blade can prevent an uprising of the undead.

programme.desc: Black comedy thriller written by Quentin Tarantino, starring Christian Slater and Patricia Arquette. When young Clarence Worley falls in love with beautiful prostitute Alabama, she's only too willing to give up her life to be with him. However, things get hot when Clarence unwittingly steals a case of cocaine and the couple flee to California with a gang of mobsters on their tail.
